no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because it was clear that the applicant had provided substantial evidence of effectiveness from two adequate and well-controlled studies, using clinical trial designs similar to those of trials for previously approved drugs for the acute treatment of migraine. Moreover, the safety profile was deemed acceptable for the treatment of migraine, without controversial issues.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for REYVOW (lasmiditan, NDA211280). The Summary Review states the application was not referred to an AdComm because the applicant had provided substantial evidence of effectiveness from two adequate and well-controlled trials and the safety profile was acceptable without controversial issues; the Medical Review confirms no AC meeting or external consultations were held. Because no committee met, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
